title: Rainbows & Beams
description: Your world feels too sad? Fix it with rainbows!
body:
![Rainbows&Beams](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5cbd9301e009266d76cc189956a24a61feee8467.png)

**Minecraft 1.16+ — Version 4**

---

## ✨ Short Wiki

- **Rainbows** can spawn after rain.  
- There are **two types of Day Rainbows**:
  - **Regular Rainbow**
  - **Twisted Rainbow**
- Day rainbows spawn with a **treasure** (that despawns with them)
- There is also a **Lunar Rainbow**, which spawns at night after rain.

---

## 🌦️ Rainbows – General Features

- Rainbows:
  - Spawn **only in the Overworld**
  - **Cannot spawn in deserts**
  - Spawn chance is increased if:
    - You have the **Luck** effect  
    - You are in a **Flower Forest**
- Rainbows will disappear if:
  - It starts raining again
  - Thunder begins
  - Night comes  
- If you didn’t collect their contents, **everything they created will be removed**.

---

## 🌈 Regular Rainbow

- The classic rainbow.
- At its base, there is always a **treasure chest**.
- You may **take only one item**.
- After taking an item:
  - The treasure
  - The rainbow  
  will **quickly disappear**.
- ⚠️ *Do not try to destroy the chest.*

---

## 🌈✨ Twisted Rainbow

- Looks unusual — the beams have a strange shape.
- At its base, you will find a **Rainbow Rock**:
  - Extremely hard
  - Obsidian-like
- Mining the Rainbow Rock gives a **50% chance** to obtain:
  - **1 of the 7 Rainbow Beam Blocks**

---

## 🌙 Lunar Rainbow

- Can spawn **at night** after rain.
- Appears white-green and has **no light**.
- Disappears:
  - After a short time
  - When the sun rises
- Has **no treasure**.
- Mostly decorative, but:
  - Its ray lets you **travel from one side of the rainbow to the other**.

---

## 🔆 Rainbow Beam Blocks

### 🌈 Types
- **7 Beam Blocks**, one for each rainbow color.

### 📏 Maximum Beam Distance by Color

| Color   | Max Distance |
|--------|--------------|
| Purple | 120 |
| Blue   | 130 |
| Aqua   | 140 |
| Green  | 150 |
| Yellow | 165 |
| Orange | 170 |
| Red    | 180 |

> The closer the color is to **red**, the longer the beam can reach.

---

## 🔋 Charging the Beam Blocks

- Beam Blocks **do not work unless charged**.
- To charge:
  - Place an **Emerald** on the block.
- Each Emerald provides:
  - **6 real-life hours** of activity  
  - *(64 Emeralds = 16 real-life days)*
- While active:
  - The block emits **green particles**.
- ⚠️ If you mine the block:
  - **Emeralds are NOT refunded**

---

## 🎯 Beam Effects

- Beam Blocks can give **6 different effects**.
- A beam:
  - Starts from the block
  - Targets the **nearest player** within range
  - **Cannot pass through blocks**
- The effect depends on the **item placed in an item frame** on top of the block.
- ⚠️ The item frame **must be placed directly on the block**, or it will not work.

---

## 🧪 Items & Effects

| Item in Item Frame | Effect Given |
|--------------------|--------------|
| Enchanted Golden Apple | Saturation |
| Sugar | Speed |
| Phantom Membrane | Slow Falling |
| Ender Eye | Glowing |
| Diamond | Resistance |
| Heart of the Sea | Conduit Power |

---

✨ *Harness the power of rainbows and bend their beams to your will!* 🌈
